decision_reason: Direct tagged-BAM inspection recovered two complete T1 and three complete T2 ONT paths with reciprocal supplementary alignments; no productive orientation, CDS start or reading frame is yet justified.
dna_only: DNA establishes a somatic chr6 rearrangement, but its displayed genomic flank concatenation is not an assembled fusion transcript.
epitope_message: Not predicted because complete RNA junction paths do not yet establish a translated CDS/frame.
interpretation: GABBR1::SLC29A1 is a genuine long-read transcript-reconstruction candidate: complete RNA paths exist in two samples, but coding interpretation remains separate from junction detection.
limitation: The public deduplicated ONT BAMs retain SA declarations without all matching observed partner records; validation used tagged BAMs and does not establish independent molecules or a translated product.
